articles.title: Crypto poured years into new products. The next challenge is keeping users
articles.snippet: Crypto firms have spent years building financial products on blockchains. Getting people to use them — and keep using them — is becoming the next challenge.

articles.title: The Clarity Act stalled. Bankers aren’t hitting the brakes yet on crypto dealmaking
articles.snippet: Crypto M&A has hit record levels, but the Clarity Act’s Senate setback leaves dealmakers weighing how much regulatory uncertainty still matters.

articles.title: Payments firm OpenPayd targets year-end Nasdaq listing to fund U.S. expansion and acquisitions
articles.snippet: CEO Iana Dimitrova said OpenPayd aims to launch in the U.S. by April 2027 and is eyeing deals to add licenses and technology.

articles.title: Crypto job postings triple to over 1,200 in September, but applications fall
articles.snippet: Finance, engineering and trading led hiring demand, while Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana were the most frequently requested blockchain skills.

articles.title: Cathie Wood says smart investors need to start watching where AI agents spend money
articles.snippet: As AI agents evolve from answering questions to spending real money, investors and tech giants are scrambling to control the financial networks powering machine-driven commerce.
